Name: NoGreenRain
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
NoGreenRainA mod that allows the disabling or forcibly enabling of green rain.Configuration[list]
[*][code]AlwaysGreenRain[/code] - if true, will make green rain [i]always[/i] occur. If false, will make green rain [i]never[/i] occur.
[*][code]AlternativeIsSun[/code] - if [code]AlwaysGreenRain[/code] is set to false, and this is set to true, it will make days that would've been green rain sunny. If set to false they will be rainy instead.
[/list]Links[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/anotherpillow/nogreenrain]Source[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26912]Download[/url]
[/list]
